description: Export and import graph structures, issue tracker items, fine-tuning trajectories, and multimodal synergy metrics. Supported actions: export_graph (export to JSON/DOT/Mermaid/HTML), export_issues (export to GitHub/Jira JSON), export_trajectories (export JSONL fine-tuning data), export_joint_trajectories (export interleaved state + vision data), export_synergy_metrics (compute dual-memory metrics), import_graph (bulk import nodes & edges), import_issues (import GitHub/Jira issues), import_spec (import PRD/Gherkin spec).

action.description: The data export or import action to execute.

edges.description: Array of edge objects for import_graph.

issues.description: Array of issue objects for import_issues.

nodes.description: Array of node objects for import_graph.

name: manage_data
